    • withWaitForSessionCreationDuration

      public SpannerConfig withWaitForSessionCreationDuration(ValueProvider<Duration> waitForSessionCreationDuration)
      Sets the wait time for a multiplexed session to be available when creating a database client.

      Setting this will block the DatabaseClient creation.

      Parameters:
      waitForSessionCreationDuration - The duration to wait. Defaults to SpannerAccessor.DEFAULT_SESSION_WAIT_DURATION.
      Returns:
      SpannerConfig
